# gws recipe: Review overdue tasks

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the review-overdue-tasks recipe: find Google Tasks that are past due and need attention — list the task lists, list uncompleted tasks (`showCompleted: false`), review due dates and prioritize the overdue ones. Distinct from `googleworkspace-cli-recipe-create-task-list` in this lot (creation vs review — the triage side of the coin). By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
